browser_verification.details: 23 new Chrome tests plus 24 existing composer and frozen-label regressions pass (47 total focused). Coverage: every root/mode and musical role/style; nearest pitch/downward ties across octaves; mono limits; GUI painting, fit/paste/transpose, save/load/JSON and undo; protected/stale/forged previews; isolated original/candidate audition; matching preview/Apply PCM; live/phrase/full export pitches; colliding MIDI-key note ownership; actual audible phrase following and held-gesture boundaries. Separate installed Google Chrome session at 1440px and 390px: generated desktop/Harmony/Compose screenshots, inspected layout, no page errors. In-app browser could not be controlled because the Mac was locked; isolated sessions did not modify the user song.
